documents.summary: Academic Affairs guidance for generative AI in teaching, learning and research. Faculty must pick one of three syllabus statements ranging from no AI to fully encouraged, and use cases are sorted into open, disclosure, oversight and prohibited categories. It adds disclosure, data-security, bias and accountability expectations, and a warning-then-tracking process for misuse.
